meta.title: Battle Beacon | More Games. Better Events.
meta.description: Battle Beacon helps players find more games and play more often. For venues, Beacon CRM fills tables and runs better events.

hero.headline: More Games.
hero.subheadline: Battle Beacon helps players find more games, play more often, and track their progress. For venues, Beacon CRM fills tables, runs better events, and keeps local gaming communities coming back.

pain.sectionHeading: The Problem With How It Works Now
pain.sectionSubheading: Players miss games, venues miss bookings, and disconnected tools make every event harder to run than it should be.

items.title: Fragmented Communication
items.description: WhatsApp groups and Discord pings get buried in the noise. Players miss game postings and venue announcements before they ever see them.

items.title: No Match Records
items.description: Manual score sheets and word of mouth are the only way to track results. History disappears the moment the game ends.

items.title: Venues Miss Bookings
items.description: Store owners have no reliable way to reach their local player base and turn interest into confirmed bookings and event signups.

items.title: Isolated Players
items.description: Without a shared hub, finding regular opponents and staying connected to local gaming communities is harder than it should be.

solution.sectionSubheading: A unified system for players to find games and venues to fill them.

items.title: Unified Discovery & Booking
items.description: Help players find games faster and make it simple for venues to turn interest into table bookings and event signups.

items.title: Player Profiles & Achievements
items.description: Give players more reasons to come back with profiles, stat tracking, awards, badges, and an exclusive early signup badge.

items.title: Venue CRM & Automation
items.description: Beacon CRM gives venues one place to manage bookings, events, customer engagement, and automations without juggling multiple tools.

cta.heading: Join Before Launch
cta.subheading: Sign up early to claim your place in the first wave of Battle Beacon players and venues, and unlock the early adopter badge before launch.
